exercises.name: Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor, keep your back flat on the bench.
Grasp the bar a little wider than shoulder width apart.
Raise the barbell above your body and move it over the middle of your chest, this is your starting position.
Lower the bar down so it just touches your chest.
Raise the bar till your arms are fully extended and your elbows are locked.
Return to starting position.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on an incline bench set at a 45 degree angle, with your feet shoulder width apart.
Grasp the bar a little wider than shoulder width apart.
Raise the barbell above your body and move it over the middle of your chest, this is your starting position.
Lower the bar down so it just touches your chest.
Raise the bar straight up till your arms are fully extended and your elbows are locked.
Return to starting position.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
steps: Lie on an incline bench which has been set to an incline of 45 degrees.
Start with the dumbbells at shoulder height, your arms wide and elbows pointing down to the floor.
Grasp the dumbbells with a grip so your palms face each other.
Raise your arms up over your chest bringing the dumbbells closer together as they meet over your chest, as if you were clapping.
Slowly return the dumbbells to starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
steps: This is an exercise for chest, triceps and shoulder strengthening.
Grasp the dumbbells in each hand and lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the ground.
Extend your arms up over your chest with your palms facing forwards.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest till your arm are fully extended this is your starting position.
Bend your elbows to a 90 degree angle so your upper arms are parallel with the floor.
Slowly lower the dumbbells as low as comfortable along your chest.
With a controlled motion return back to your starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Grasp the bar at a grip 3-6 inches wider than your shoulders.
Raise the bar above your chest, keeping your elbows close in.
Slowly and with control lower the bar straight to your lower chest.
Raise the bar back up to starting position with the bar just above your chest.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
steps: Adjust the machine so that you are sitting with the bars at chest height.
Place your hands on the bars and place your feet on the foot rest.
Press out, extending your arms as far as possible in a steady motion.
Pause for a moment and then return slowly to starting position.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
steps: Adjust the machine seat so your shoulders are aligned with the pivot point of the arms.
Sit with your back flat against the pad and grasp the handles with a slight bend in your elbows.
Bring the handles together in front of your chest, squeezing your pecs.
Control the movement as you slowly return the handles to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
steps: Attach the cable pulley to shoulder height.
Grasp the pulley in both hands and stand approximately one foot in front of the weight stacks, with one foot slightly in front of the other.
With a slight bend in your elbows bring your hand together in front of your chest on downward angle.
When your hands meet at the midpoint of your chest, hold for a moment.
With a slow controlled motion return to starting position.

exercises.name: Push-up
steps: Start with a basic push up, lay face down on the floor, or a mat; with your feet together curled slightly so you rise onto the ball of your feet.
Place you hands shoulder width apart on the either side of your chest.
Draw your abs in.
Inhale as you raise your body up till your arms are straight.
Keep your head and neck level with your body (don’t look up or down) and don’t allow your back to rise or fall.
Exhale out as you lower your body back to the ground.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Weighted Push-up
steps: Place a weight plate or other suitable resistance on your upper back.
Start in a plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward, and body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and glutes.
Lower your chest towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push through your hands to extend your arms and return to the starting plank position.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
steps: Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold it at your collarbone.
Brace your core and press the bar straight up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position at your upper chest with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
steps: Sit on a flat bench, feet point forward with your abs drawn in.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with your palm facing towards your body
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees and raise both your arms to the starting point in line with your shoulders.
With a steady controlled motion raise your arms up while straightening your elbows while rotating your forearms so that your palms now face away from your body.
Bring the dumbbells closer together but do not fully extend your elbows.
With a controlled motion lower the dumbbells to the starting position at your shoulders.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
steps: Grasp a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inward towards your body and the dumbbells at your sides.
Standing with your feet shoulder with apart, draw your abs in and bend your knees slightly.
While keeping your torso still, raise the your arms up to the sides keeping your arms straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise your arms up until in line with your shoulders, your palms should face the floor.
Hold the position for a moment then in a controlled movement lower your arms to the starting position.
Repeat

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
steps: Stand beside a low cable pulley and grasp the handle with your outside hand.
Keep your torso upright and raise your arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower the handle back down across your body in a controlled movement.

exercises.name: Front Raise
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, your feet shoulder width apart and your abs drawn in.
Keeping each arm straight raise your left arm to just above shoulder height.
Pause for a moment then in a controlled motion lower the weight to starting position and repeat with your right arm.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
steps: Bend forward at your hips with a flat back, holding dumbbells beneath your chest.
Raise both dumbbells out to the sides while maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells back down slowly to complete the movement.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
steps: Sit facing the machine and grip the handles with your arms extended forward at shoulder height.
Push the handles backward in an arc by squeezing your upper back and rear delts.
Return the handles to the starting position in a slow and controlled manner.

exercises.name: Face Pull
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grasp it with both hands facing the anchor point.
Pull the middle of the rope directly toward your face while separating your hands and leading with your elbows.
Extend your arms forward to return the rope to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Upright Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and back straight.
Place the bar on rack in the position where your arms are fully extended in front of you with your elbows slightly bent.
Place your hands shoulder width apart and raise the bar up towards your chin with a controlled motion.
Pause at the top for a moment and rotate your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar to the starting position.
Repeat

exercises.name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart so that your feet are under the bar.
Keeping your back straight bend at the waist, allow some bend in your knees.
Grasp the par with an overhand grip approximately 16 inches apart.
Straighten your back as you hold the bar at arm’s length.
Bend over again lowering the bar to just above the floor.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Place a barbell in front of your feet on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a grip a bit wider than shoulder width apart.
Bend your knees slightly, keeping your hips and back straight.
Lift the bar straight up concentrating on using your hips as you stand.
Stand with the bar resting against your thighs.
Lower the bar to the floor with a slight bend in your knees flexing your hips back for stability.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
steps: Bend over a barbell at slight angle with your knees bent and your back straight.
Grasp the bar with a reverse grip (palms facing up) and slowly pull the barbell to your abs, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Return the barbell to the starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
steps: Place your feet on either side of a T-Bar Machine.
With your knees slightly bent and abs drawn in, grasp the handles with a narrow grip.
Bend at the waist so your chest is parallel to the floor, this is starting position. Slowly pull the bar to your chest, as high as you can.
Pause at the top for a moment and then lower the bar to starting position.
Repeat

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent Over Row
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward at your hips with a flat back.
Keep your arms hanging down toward the floor with your palms facing each other.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back.
Lower the dumbbells back down in a controlled manner to the starting position.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
steps: Place one knee and the corresponding hand on a flat bench to support your torso.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand with your arm fully extended toward the floor.
Pull the dumbbell upward toward your hip by driving your elbow toward the ceiling.
Lower the dumbbell in a controlled motion back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Row
steps: Adjust the machine so your chest is firmly supported on the pad.
Grasp the handles with your preferred grip.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Control the movement as you extend your arms back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
steps: Sit at a low pulley machine with your feet resting against the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
With your abs drawn in and your back straight lean forward slightly to grasp the pulleys with an overhand grip (palms face downwards).
Slowly bring the pulleys back towards your abs while sitting upright, keep your elbows in close to your chest.
Pause for a moment then return slowly return the pulleys to the starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Machine Row
steps: Sit on the machine and adjust the seat or chest pad for proper alignment.
Grasp the handles with your preferred grip.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Control the movement as you extend your arms back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
steps: Sitting upright with your abs drawn in grasp a Pull Down bar with and underhand grip shoulder width apart.
Pull the bar down till the bar reaches your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Attach a V bar to the pull down pulley of a cable machine.
Sitting upright with your abs drawn grasp the bar with an overhand grip, your palms facing in.
Pull the bar straight down to your upper chest.
Pause for a moment after touching the chest and then slowly return the bar to starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
steps: Grasp wide grip pull down bar with a wide grip so your hands are on the portion of the bar which curves down.
Stand erect with your abs drawn in.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows and your wrist steady pull the bar down from the starting position to your upper thighs.
With a controlled motion bring the bar back up to starting position.

exercises.name: Pull-up
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with the palms facing forward using the prescribed grip.

As you have both arms extended in front of you holding the bar at the chosen grip width, bring your torso back around 30 degrees or so while creating a curvature on your lower back and sticking your chest out. This is your starting position.
Pull your torso up until the bar touches your upper chest by drawing the shoulders and the upper arms down and back. Exhale as you perform this portion of the movement.
After a second on the contracted position, start to inhale and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position when your arms are fully extended and the lats are fully stretched.
Repeat this motion.
Tip

Concentrate on squeezing the back muscles once you reach the full contracted position. The upper torso should remain stationary as it moves through space and only the arms should move. The forearms should do no other work other than hold the bar.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-up
steps: Select your desired assistance weight on the machine.
Step onto the platform and grasp the handles with your preferred grip.
Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar or your upper chest touches it.
Control the movement as you slowly lower yourself back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-up
steps: Attach the desired weight to a dip belt around your waist.
Grasp the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and feet off the ground.
Pull your body upwards by driving your elbows down, until your chin clears the bar.
Slowly lower your body with control until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: Chin-up
steps: Grasp the bar with an supinated (overhand) grip so that your palms are facing.
Let your body hang from the bar with your arms straight.
Slowly pull yourself up so that your chin is higher than the bar.
With a controlled movement lower yourself to the starting position.
Repeat

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
steps: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip in front of your thighs.
Keep your arms straight and let the barbell hang naturally.
Elevate your shoulders straight up towards your ears as high as possible.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Squat
steps: This is an exercise for leg strengthening, mainly the quadriceps.
Lifting a barbell off of a weight rack, position it on your shoulders.
Place your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart with your knees and toes pointed slightly outward.
Drawing your abs in descend slowly by bending at the knees and hips as if you are sitting down (squatting).
Lower yourself as far as you can control without letting your body shift towards your toes (this will cause you to loose balance).
Pause in the downward position and slowly return upright to the starting position.

exercises.name: Front Squat
steps: The Front Squat works the same muscles as the rear squat without placing the weight of the bar on your shoulders. This exercise can be a good substitute for people with back and neck injuries.
Place the barbell on your upper chest, resting it across your front deltoids and holding it with your arms crossed securely.
Keep your head and back straight, abs drawn in and toes pointing slightly outward.
Slowly “squat” down so your upper thighs are parallel to the floor.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Note: Practice the squat without any weight to allow yourself to become comfortable with the movements.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
steps: This exercise is a variation of the Squat which uses a machine.  This exercise may be preferred by beginners.
Lie face up on a Hack Squat machine with your shoulders against the pad.
Place your feet facing forward at slightly less than shoulder width apart with your toes point slightly outward.
Release the dock levers and place your hands on the hand grips.
Drawing your abs in, extend your body standing upright.
Lower your body to a squatting position so you knees are bent as if you were sitting down.
Return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Leg Press
steps: Along with the Squat, this exercise is crucial for building and strengthening the legs.
Adjust the seat of the machine so that your feet comfortably reach the crosspiece with a slight bend in your knees.
To begin, press your feet forward at a shoulder width stance and release the safety locks.
Slowly lower the weight towards your body, keeping your abs drawn in and your knees moving in the same direction as your feet to a 90 degree angle.
Do not lock your knees or bounce the weight.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand facing away from a bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place the top of one foot on the bench behind you, keeping your front foot flat on the floor.
Lower your body by bending your front knee, allowing your back knee to drop towards the floor.
Descend until your front thigh is parallel to the floor, maintaining an upright torso.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Complete all repetitions on one leg before switching to the other.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
steps: Start by grasping a dumbbell in each hand.
Stand with your feet about 8 inches apart, toes facing forward.
Take a lunge forward keeping your abs drawn in and your upper body straight.
Slowly lower one knee down as if kneeling while keeping your other knee bent at a 90 degree angle, do not let your knee touch the ground.
Lower your body to just above the floor and hold for a moment before pushing off with the back foot.
Step through and repeat the exercise with the other leg.

exercises.name: Step-Up
steps: Place a bench, box or step in front of you.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand.
With your left leg, step up on the bench, and follow by stepping up with your right leg.
Step down with your left leg and then your right leg.
Repeat starting with your right leg.
Note: Use a lighter weight until you are used to the motion of this exercise.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
steps: Adjust the seat so that your knees have full range of motion and that the footpad fits over your legs, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles with your hands for support, keeping your hip and back against the bench.
Slowly extend your legs until your knees are straight, but do not lock your knees.
Hold for a moment and then with controlled movements return to the starting position.
Note: Use controlled movements for this exercise, do not swing the weight up.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down on a leg curl machine and place your heels under the roller pad.
Grasp the grips with your hands for support and slowly curl your ankles up towards your back.
Hold for a moment and then return to starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
steps: Adjust the machine so that the footpad is just above your heels.
Sit upright with your abs drawn in and your legs in front of you.
Slowly curl your legs back towards you and hold for a moment.
With controlled movement return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench and a barbell positioned directly over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor with your knees bent at a right angle.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your thighs and torso align horizontally.
Lower your hips in a controlled manner back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Lift up hips and bum off the floor as you draw your abs in and keep your gluts tight.

exercises.name: Good Morning
steps: Place a barbell across your shoulders.
Keeping your head up and your back completely straight, bend at the waist until your back is parallel with the floor.
Return to starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
steps: This exercise uses a machine to allow for proper form.
Stand with your toes on the footpad of the machine and adjust your shoulders under the upper pads.
Raise up on the balls of your feet, lifting your heels off the pad.
Hold for a moment and then return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit at a calf raise machine.
Put the balls of your feet on the footpad.
Place your thighs under the leg pad above your knees.
Unlock the bar and slowly raise your toes up as far as possible.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: Practice slow and precise movements with this exercise.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl
steps: Stand with our feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up.
Extend your arms so they are at the sides of your body.
Keeping your elbows, locked lift your arms to your chest so that your forearms touch your biceps.
In a slow controlled manner, lower your arms to the starting position.
Note: Do not swing your body as you perform this exercise.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
steps: This exercise uses a hammering (up and down) motion to isolate the biceps.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand so your palms are facing each other.
Extend your arms so they are at the sides of your body.
Keeping your elbows locked lift your arms in an arc towards your shoulders.
Lower your arms in a steady controlled motion and repeat.
Note: Do not turn your wrists during this exercise.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
steps: A Preacher Curl uses a special bench to support the triceps and isolate the biceps to build the arms. This version of the exercises is a machine exercise. This is a good exercise for beginners.

Adjust the seat of the bench so your arms are level with the top of the bench. Rest your arms against the bench and extend them fully. Grasp the bar underhand (palms facing up) and pull it towards your head. Pause for a moment and then lower the bar back to starting position.
Note: Perform this exercise in a slow controlled manner for best results. Read the instructions on the machine before performing this exercise.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
steps: Attach a short bar to a cable pulley to the bottom of the weight stack.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in.
Grasp the bar with palms facing up, and hands fairly close together.
Lower your arms fully to above your thighs and bending only your elbows, raise the bar to your upper chest.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: Do not swing your hips or back during this exercise.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
steps: Grasp a barbell with an overhand grip with hands shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your arms fully extended downward in front of your thighs.
Keep your elbows fixed at your sides and curl the barbell upward toward your chest.
Squeeze your forearms at the top of the movement.
Lower the barbell slowly back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
steps: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip, resting your forearms on your thighs with your wrists hanging off the knees.
Allow the barbell to roll down into your fingers to fully stretch your wrists.
Flex your wrists upward to curl the barbell as high as possible.
Squeeze your forearms at the top of the movement.
Lower the barbell in a controlled motion back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
steps: Stand in front of a cable machine and attach a short bar to a high pulley.
Grasp the handle with your palms facing down.
Draw your abs in and keep your back straight.
Keeping your elbows at your side push the handle down towards your thighs.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: You may want to stager one foot in front of the other for a better stance.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Attach a rope handle to a low cable pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope with both hands behind your head with your elbows pointing upward.
Keep your upper arms stationary next to your head.
Extend your arms upward until they are fully straight.
Lower the rope slowly behind your head to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your head at one end.
Grasp an EZ or Curl bar with an overhand grip.
Raise the bar straight up over your shoulders, taking care to keep your elbows in close.
Slowly lower the bar in an arc over your head.
Return the bar to the starting position.
Note: Keep your arms straight throughout this exercise moving only your elbows.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor, keep your back flat on the bench.
Grasp the bar a close grip (approximately 14” apart).
Raise the barbell above your body and move it over the middle of your chest, this is your starting position.
Lower the bar down so it just touches your chest.
Raise the bar till your arms are fully extended and your elbows are locked.
Return to starting position.

exercises.name: Dip
steps: Grasp a set of parallel bars and push yourself up to the starting position.
Keeping your elbows close to your body, lower yourself down until your triceps are parallel to the floor.
Slowly raise yourself back to the starting position.
Note: Keep your abs drawn in and your body straight during this exercise.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
steps: Adjust the seat of the machine so that the handles are equal with your elbows.
Grasping the handles, press down with equal pressure until your arms are fully extended.
Pause, and then return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Plank
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your forearms resting on the mat.
Lift your hips and torso off the ground, supporting your weight on your forearms and toes.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels by engaging your core.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor to finish.

exercises.name: Side Plank
steps: Lay on one side of your body with your legs straight and your forearm perpendicular to your body in front of you.
Drawing your abs in, slowly raise yourself up so you are balanced on your feet and your forearm.
Hold this position and slowly return back to the starting position.
Repeat on other side.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs up towards the ceiling while keeping them straight.
Pause when your legs are parallel to the floor.
Lower your legs back down in a controlled manner to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
steps: Attach a rope to a high cable pulley.
Place a bench in front of cable weight stack.
Grasp the rope over your shoulders and sit with your back towards the stack.
With your feet firmly on the floor and keeping your hips steady, flex at the waist bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Return to the starting position.
Note: Perform this exercise in a slow controlled manner.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Place a barbell on the floor at your feet.
Bending at the waist, grip the barbell with a shoulder with overhand grip.
With a slow controlled motion, roll the bar out so that your back is straight.
Keep your arms straight throughout the exercise.
Roll back up raising your hips and butt as you return to the starting position.
Note: Practice raising your hips and butt as high as you can with this exercise.

exercises.name: Running
steps: Stand tall with your chest open and shoulders relaxed.
Begin moving forward at a running pace, striking the ground with your midfoot.
Swing your arms naturally from your shoulders in rhythm with your stride.
Slow your pace gradually until you come to a stop.

exercises.name: Walking
steps: Stand upright with your posture tall and your gaze forward.
Step forward with one foot, heel striking first, and roll through to your toes.
Pump your arms gently at your sides to maintain momentum.
Slow your steps down gradually to finish.

exercises.name: Cycling
steps: Adjust the bicycle seat height and mount the bike with your feet on the pedals.
Begin pedaling forward in a smooth circular motion.
Maintain a steady cadence with your upper body relaxed.
Slow your pedaling rate gradually to come to a halt.

exercises.name: Rowing
steps: Sit on the rower and secure your feet in the footstraps.
Grab the handle with both hands and extend your legs to drive backward.
Lean your torso back slightly and pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Extend your arms and bend your knees to return to the starting position in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
steps: Step onto the machine and place your hands lightly on the console rails.
Begin stepping upward continuously as the steps rotate downward.
Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning heavily on the rails.
Slow the machine's speed gradually before stepping off.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
steps: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet firmly on the ground.
Lift the dumbbells over your chest extending your arms fully with a slight bend in your elbows, this is your starting position.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells to the floor in an arc like motion.
Slowly return the dumbbells over your chest to the starting position in a controlled motion.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Incline Cable Fly
steps: Place an incline bench set at a 45 degree angle between two cable towers.
Grasp a pulley in each hand with your palms facing up.
With a slight bend in your elbows, squeeze your chest and pull the cables in an arc so they meet together in the middle of your chest.
Hold for a moment and then slowly lower your hands back to starting position at along the same arc.

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
steps: Grasp the dumbbells your hands and lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Raise the dumbbells above your chest, bringing your elbows close in, this is your starting position.
Slowly and with control lower the dumbbells to either side of your lower chest.
Raise the dumbbells back up to starting position.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
steps: Place a flat bench in the middle of the Smith Machine, with the bar in line with the middle of your chest.
Lying on the bench, grasp the bar at shoulder width apart.
Unlatch the bar and slowly lower the bar to your chest.
Extend your arms fully and raise the bar to the starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
steps: Attach one end of a barbell into a landmine anchor and load the opposite end with weight.
Grasp the loaded end of the barbell with both hands at shoulder height with your feet stance wide.
Press the barbell forward and upward until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position in a controlled movement.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
steps: Stand in between the parallel bars.
Grip the handles of the parallel bars and push yourself up to the starting position with straightened arms.
With your elbows close to your body keep your hips straight, lower your body forward by bending your elbows so your chest is leading as you go down.
Raise yourself back up to the starting position and repeat.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
steps: Secure a weight to your dip belt and stand between the parallel bars.
Grip the handles and push up to the starting position with your arms fully extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows while keeping your torso slightly tilted forward.
Push through your palms to return to the starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
steps: Situate yourself on the shoulder press machine and adjust the seat height so the handles align with your shoulders.
Grip the handles with your palms facing forward and your feet flat on the floor.
Press the handles upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower the handles back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Press
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your back straight as you prepare to move.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height in a controlled motion.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Push Press
steps: Rest a barbell across your front deltoids with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Initiate a shallow dip by bending your knees slightly while keeping your torso upright.
Drive explosively upward through your legs to propel the barbell overhead.
Lock your arms out fully at the top and lower the barbell back to your shoulders with control.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
steps: Sit on the lateral raise machine and place your forearms against the pads.
Grip the handles and keep your chest pressed against the backrest.
Raise your arms outward until they are parallel to the floor.
Lower the pads back to the starting position in a controlled movement.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Cable Front Raise
steps: Place the pulley on the setting just above the floor.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your abs drawn in and your knees slightly bent.
Starting at waist height, take the pulley in your left hand, palm facing the floor with otherwise known as an overhand grip, and raise your straight arm up towards your left shoulder.
At shoulder height pause for a moment.
With a controlled movement resist the weight and slowly lower your arm back to starting position at your waist.
Repeat the exercise with your right arm.

exercises.name: Plate Front Raise
steps: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands in front of your thighs.
Engage your core and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the plate upward until your arms reach shoulder level.
Lower the plate back to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
steps: Hinge forward at your hips with a flat back while holding dumbbells.
Let your arms hang straight down beneath your shoulders.
Raise both dumbbells out to the sides by driving your elbows upward.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
steps: Set the cable pulleys at shoulder height and cross your arms to grasp opposite handles.
Step back slightly and maintain a stable stance with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the cables apart and across by moving your arms outward and backward.
Return your arms to the center position in a slow and controlled manner.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hinge at your hips to grab the barbell on the floor.
Keep your back parallel to the ground and brace your core.
Explosively pull the barbell up until it contacts your lower chest or upper abdomen.
Lower the barbell rapidly back to the floor while maintaining your flat back position.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
steps: Lie under a bar so that the bar is at mid chest level and your feet are firmly on the floor.
Draw your abs in and keep your back flat.
Using your arms, lift and row your body towards the bar.
Pause for a moment and with slow controlled movements lower your self back to starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
steps: Stand perpendicular to a landmine barbell with one hand gripping the sleeve handle.
Hinge at your hips and stagger your stance with your inside foot back.
Pull the barbell upward by driving your elbow toward the ceiling.
Lower the barbell back to the fully extended position with control.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
steps: Attach a single handle to a low cable pulley and grasp it with one hand.
Step back to create tension and establish a stable split stance.
Pull the handle toward your ribs by driving your elbow straight back.
Extend your arm to return the handle to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Grasp the lat pulldown bar with a wide overhand grip and sit down on the pad.
Lean your torso back slightly and lift your chest toward the ceiling.
Pull the bar down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back.
Return the bar to the starting position in a smooth, controlled motion.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-up
steps: Grasp the bar with an supinated (overhand) grip so that your palms are facing.
Let your body hang from the bar with your arms straight.
Slowly pull yourself up so that your chin is higher than the bar.
With a controlled movement lower yourself to the starting position.
Repeat

exercises.name: Assisted Chin-up
steps: Select the desired assistance weight on the machine stack.
Step onto the platform or kneel on the pad with an underhand grip on the handles.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the top of the handles.
Lower your body back to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Weighted Chin-up
steps: Secure a weight using a dip belt or hold a dumbbell between your feet.
Grasp the pull-up bar with an underhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Pull your body up until your chin passes over the bar.
Lower yourself back down to the starting hang position under complete control.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
steps: Set the safety pins of a rack just below your knee level and place the barbell on them.
Stand close to the bar, hinge at your hips, and grasp the barbell with an overhand or mixed grip.
Drive your hips forward and lift the barbell until you stand fully upright.
Lower the barbell back to rest on the safety pins with control.

exercises.name: Back Extension
steps: Adjust the hyperextension bench so that your ankles are tucked under the footpads and your thighs are flat across the top pad.
With your arms folded across your chest and your back straight, slowly bend at the waist towards the floor, keeping your back flat.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and a slight bend in your knees.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and with your arms at your sides.
Lower your shoulders as much as possible.
With your arms straight raise both shoulders up towards your ears.
Hold the upright positions for a moment and then lower in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands under the top weight.
Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower your body into a deep squat.
Push through your midfoot to extend your hips and knees to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
steps: This exercise uses the Smith Machine to work the Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Calves and Glutes. A great overall exercise for the lower body. There are many variations on the squat, this is the original version using a Smith Machine for better flow of movement.
Set the height of the barbell to shoulder height.
Place your feet slightly wider than shoulder width apart with your knees and toes pointed slightly outward.
Drawing your abs in descend slowly by bending at the knees and hips as if you are sitting down (squatting).
Lower yourself as far as you can control without letting your body shift over your toes (this will cause you to loose balance).
Pause in the downward squatting position and slowly return upright to the starting position.

If needed, a pad on the bar or towel on your shoulders can help improve your grip and the reduce the discomfort of the bar against your back. First practice the squat without any weight to allow yourself to become comfortable with the movements.

exercises.name: Belt Squat
steps: Step onto the platform and secure the belt snugly around your waist.
Attach the belt strap to the loading pin or anchor point of the machine.
Release the safety catches and push your hips back to bend your knees into a deep squat.
Drive through your feet to extend your legs and hips back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed outward toward the weights.
Bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell with your hands placed inside your legs.
Lift the bar by extending your hips and knees while keeping your chest up and back flat.
Lower the bar back to the floor in a controlled motion by bending at the hips and knees.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
steps: Step inside the trap bar and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to grasp the side handles.
Drive through your feet to stand up straight, extending your hips and knees simultaneously.
Lower the bar back down to the floor by reversing the movement with control.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
steps: Lie face down on a leg curl machine and place your heels under the roller pad.
Grasp the grips with your hands for support and slowly curl your ankles up towards your back.
Hold for a moment and then return to starting position.
Repeat.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Secure your ankles under a padded anchor or have a partner hold them down while kneeling on a pad.
Keep your body straight from your knees to your shoulders and your arms crossed over your chest.
Slowly lower your torso toward the floor by resisting with your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands on the floor and push off to help return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at your hips to lower the dumbbell toward the floor while extending your free leg straight back behind you.
Keep your back flat and your hips level as you descend.
Drive through your standing heel to return to an upright position.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
steps: This is an advanced version of a lunge.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand.
Stand with your feet approximately 8 inches apart with your toes pointing forward.
Slowly take a step backward with your right leg.
Keeping your abs drawn in and your upper body straight, lower your body until your left knee is almost on the ground. You may choose to place a mat or towel under your knee.
Hold for a moment and then return to starting position.

exercises.name: Split Squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing away from a bench.
Place the top of your back foot on the bench and step your front foot forward.
Lower your hips by bending your front knee until your back knee is just above the floor.
Press through your front foot to extend your leg and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
steps: Standing at a cable tower attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley.
Facing the weight stack, with a slight bend in your knees and your abs drawn in
Slowly kick your ankle back in and arc as high as you are able to.
Return to starting position and switch ankles.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
steps: Sit on the machine and adjust the pads against the outside of your thighs.
Select your weight and grasp the handles.
Push your legs outward against the pads as far as possible.
Return slowly to the starting position.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift one leg straight up into the air.
Drive through the heel of the planted foot to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips back down in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor with your knees bent.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your thighs and torso align.
Lower the barbell back to the floor in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place a dumbbell securely across your hips, holding it with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips upward.
Lower your hips slowly back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hip crease and hold it securely.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso and thighs form a straight line.
Lower your hips back down in a controlled movement.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
steps: Position a bench parallel to a Smith machine and sit on the floor with your upper back against it.
Roll the bar so it rests across your hip crease and unrack it.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Lower the bar back down in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Stand inside a Smith machine with the bar resting on your upper traps or gripped in front of you.
Unrack the bar and maintain a soft bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips, pushing your glutes back while lowering the bar along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold a pair of dumbbells in front of your thighs with a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips, pushing your glutes backward while keeping your back straight.
Lower the dumbbells smoothly along the front of your legs.
Drive your hips forward to return to the standing position.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your body with your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at your hips, sending your glutes back as you lower the kettlebell toward the floor.
Descend until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Straddle the cable with the rope passing between your legs and hold the ends.
Hinge at your hips, pushing your glutes back while allowing your torso to lean forward.
Drive your hips forward to return to an upright standing position.

exercises.name: Machine Glute Kickback
steps: Adjust the machine settings and position one foot against the resistance pad.
Grip the handles and brace your core.
Push the pad backward by extending your hip as far as comfortable.
Return the pad slowly to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Attach a ankle strap to a low cable pulley and fasten it to your outer ankle.
Stand sideways to the cable machine and hold the frame for support.
Sweep your working leg outward and away from your body against the resistance.
Return the leg slowly to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction
steps: Attach a ankle strap to a low cable pulley and fasten it to your inner ankle.
Stand sideways to the cable machine with your working foot furthest from the anchor point.
Pull your working leg inward across the midline of your body against the resistance.
Return the leg slowly to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
steps: Sit on the machine and adjust the pads against the insides of your thighs.
Grip the handles for stability and keep your posture upright.
Press your legs together inward against the pad resistance.
Return your legs slowly to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Position the barbell across your upper back and stand facing away from the bench.
Place the top of your back foot onto an elevated bench behind you.
Lower your hips by bending your front knee until your back knee nears the floor.
Drive through your front foot to push your body back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
steps: Position the barbell across your upper back and stand upright.
Step one foot backward and lower your hips until both knees form right angles.
Drive through your front foot to push your body back up to the starting position.
Return the back foot to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
steps: Position the barbell across your upper back and adopt a staggered stance.
Keep your torso upright and your weight distributed across your front foot.
Lower your hips straight down by bending both knees.
Drive through your front foot to raise your body back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Heel-Elevated Goblet Squat
steps: Stand with your heels elevated on plates or a wedge and hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest.
Brace your core and keep your torso as upright as possible.
Lower your hips by bending your knees and ankles until your thighs break parallel.
Drive through your midfoot to push yourself back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
steps: Hold a single dumbbell vertically with both hands in front of your hips.
Take a wide stance with your toes pointed outward at an angle.
Lower your hips by bending your knees while keeping your torso upright.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Deadlift
steps: Place a heavy dumbbell vertically on the floor between your feet.
Adopt a wide stance with your toes pointed outward and grip the top handle of the dumbbell.
Drive your hips forward and push through your feet to stand up straight.
Lower the dumbbell back to the floor by hinging at your hips in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Front-Foot Elevated Split Squat
steps: Stand with your front foot elevated on a small plate or platform and hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step your other foot backward into a staggered stance.
Lower your hips straight down toward the floor by bending both knees.
Drive through your front foot to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Deficit Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand with your working foot on top of a small plate or platform and hold dumbbells at your sides.
Step your back foot off the platform backward and lower your hips toward the floor.
Drive through your front foot to push your body upward.
Bring the back foot back onto the platform in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand upright holding dumbbells at your sides.
Take a large step to the side with one foot while pushing your hips backward and bending that knee.
Keep your opposite leg straight and your torso relatively upright.
Push off the stepping foot to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step your right foot behind and across your left leg.
Bend both knees to lower your hips toward the floor.
Push through your left heel to stand back up.
Return your right foot to the starting position.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
steps: Load one end of a barbell into a landmine attachment.
Hold the free end of the bar with both hands at chest height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Drive through your feet to extend your legs and return to the start.

exercises.name: Landmine Romanian Deadlift
steps: Load one end of a barbell into a landmine fixture.
Grasp the sleeve of the bar with both hands just below chest level.
Stand upright with a slight bend in your knees.
Hinge at your hips to push your glutes back while lowering your torso.
Drive your hips forward to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and a kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge at your hips and grip the kettlebell handle with both hands.
Pull the kettlebell back between your legs to initiate the swing.
Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the bell up to chest height.
Control the descent as the kettlebell swings back between your legs.

exercises.name: Glute-Focused Back Extension
steps: Position yourself on a back extension bench with your hips resting just above the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body toward the floor by bending at the waist.
Contract your glutes to lift your torso until it aligns with your legs.
Lower your torso back down in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
steps: Lie face down on a reverse hyperextension machine with your upper body secured.
Attach your ankles to the padded roller.
Engage your glutes to lift your legs upward until they form a straight line with your torso.
Lower your legs back down to the starting position in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
steps: This is an old school gym exercise which requires the assistance of another person. This is an advanced exercise and not recommended for beginners.
Bend your waist and lean your arms against a weight rack or bench that is waist height.
Have a partner sit on top of your lower back.
Raise up on your toes leaning slightly forward.
Pause at the top and then lower your heels to the floor.
Note: Have a Personal Trainer or Instructor show you how to perform this exercise safely.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: This exercise uses a Leg Press Machine to work your calves. You can perform this exercise along with Leg Presses.
Sit down on a Leg Press Machine and press the plate up as if you were performing a leg press.
Slide your feet down so that the balls of your feet are pressing against the rack (with your heels hanging free).
Keeping the handles locked, press up and flex your toes and then slowly bring your toes back towards your body.
Perform theses movements slowly for maximum benefit.
Note: Use a lighter weight on this exercise than you are able to lift with a leg press until you are familiar with the movements.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall.
Walk your feet forward and slide your back down the wall.
Stop when your thighs are parallel to the floor and your knees form a right angle.
Hold this position while keeping your core braced.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Drive forcefully through your entire foot to jump straight up into the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately absorb the impact by descending into the next squat.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Adjust an incline bench to a 45 degree angle.
Grasp a dumbbell in each hand and sit back on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the floor.
Allow your arms to hang down at your sides.
Keeping your elbow straight, raise your right arm up towards your head.
In a controlled manner lower the weight and repeat with your left arm.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat and your legs spread apart.
Grasp a dumbbell in your hand, palms facing up.
With your elbow pressed against your inner thigh, curl the dumbbell up towards your chest.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat and switch arms.
Note: Keep all of your body still except the arm you are exercising.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with palms up.
Lower the bar so it is against your thighs.
Keeping your elbows still, raise the bar up to your chest so that your forearms touch your biceps.
Note: Lean up against a wall or post to keep yourself from swaying.

exercises.name: Spider Curl
steps: This exercise uses the straight side of a Preacher Curl bench to increase the range of motion of the exercise.
Turn a Preacher Curl bench around so you are leaning against the angled side.
Grasp a barbell with palms up, approximately 6 inches apart.
Leaning against the bench, lower the bar along the flat side of the bench fully extending your arms.
Curl your arms up so your biceps are touching your forearms.
Slowly lower the bar to the starting position.
Note: Use a low weight to get used to the motion of this exercise.

exercises.name: Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Using the rope with the cable machine allows you isolate the biceps with this version of the Hammer Curl. This is a good exercise for beginners.

Attach a rope to a cable pulley to the bottom of the weight stack. Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent and your abs drawn in. Grasp the rope with a close underhand grip (palms facing up). Lower your arms fully to above your thighs and bending only your elbows, raise the rope to your upper chest. Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: Keep your elbows at your side throughout this exercise. Do not swing your hips or back during this exercise.

exercises.name: Drag Curl
steps: This exercise is credited to the late Vince Gironda, the “Iron Guru”. It not only blasts the biceps and works the forearms as well.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, your knees slightly bent, and your abs drawn in.
Grasp the bar with palms down, shoulder width apart.
Extend your arms fully so they are against your thighs.
Slowly raise your arms, palms down, to touch your chest.
Note: Do not move your elbows or shoulders during this exercise.

exercises.name: Rope Tricep Pushdown
steps: Stand in front of a cable machine and attach a rope to a high pulley.
Grasp the rope with palms facing down.
Draw your abs in and keep your back straight.
Keeping your elbows at your side push the rope down towards your thighs, if possible “split” the rope apart at the bottom.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Note: You may want to stager one foot in front of the other for a better stance.

exercises.name: Two Dumbbell Skullcrusher
steps: Lay on a flat bench with your head at one end and your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Grasp a dumbbell with both hands with palms facing up.
Raise dumbbell over your body. Your arms will be pointed towards the ceiling.
While keeping your upper arms and elbows still, lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head.
Slowly raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Single Dumbbell Skullcrusher
steps: Lie flat on a bench holding a single dumbbell with both hands by the handle.
Extend your arms upward so the dumbbell is positioned directly over your shoulders.
Keep your upper arms stationary as you bend your elbows to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Reverse the movement by extending your elbows to return the dumbbell to the starting position.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Sit on a short, straight backed bench with your feet planted firmly on the floor.
Drawing your abs in, grasp the dumbbell with both hands with a palms up grip.
Raise the weight over your head, this is your starting position.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc from above your head to behind your back.
Slowly return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Single Arm Dumbbell Tricep Extension
steps: Sit on a bench holding a dumbbell in one hand with your arm extended overhead.
Keep your torso upright and your core braced.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head in a controlled arc.
Extend your arm upward to return the dumbbell to the starting position.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
steps: This exercise is one of the most basic and still one of the best for building the triceps (muscles on the back of the arm).
Place two benches parallel to each other 3-4 feet apart.
Sit on one bench and place your feet on the edge of the other bench so that your legs are suspended between the 2 benches.
Cross your feet for support.
Hold onto the bench with your hands for support and slowly lower body towards the floor by bending your elbows.
Pause and then return to starting position.
Note: Do not go below a 90 degree angle as this can cause on your shoulders.

exercises.name: Tricep Kickback
steps: Standing along side a flat bench, bend your left knee and place it on the bench.
Place your left hand on the bench for support, keeping your back at a 45 degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in your right hand and place your right foot on the floor.
Bend your right arm and raise it up to your shoulder, then with controlled motion kick it back, fully extending your arm.
Switch arms and repeat.
Note: Keep your elbow close to your body during this exercise.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension
steps: Sit on a bench holding light dumbbells with an overhand grip, resting your forearms on your thighs with your wrists hanging over your knees.
Keep your forearms stationary against your legs.
Lower the dumbbells toward the floor by flexing your wrists downward.
Extend your wrists upward as high as possible to lift the dumbbells.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
steps: Grab a pair of heavy dumbbells and stand tall.
Engage your core and keep your shoulders back.
Walk forward with controlled strides.
Maintain an upright posture throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Crunch
steps: This is the most common abdominal exercise and possibly the most often improperly performed. Here is how to perform it correctly.
Lie on your back with your feet up on a bench and your knees bent at a 90 degree angle.
Place your hands across your chest or on either side of your head (over your ears).
Raise your head, shoulders and chest off the floor and towards your knees, crunching your abs.
Hold the position for a moment and then lower to the starting position.
Note: Keep your hips straight and your lower back against the floor during this exercise.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie on your back with your arms outstretched to your sides.
Bend your knees at a 60 degree angle and hold your feet up just off the floor.
Keeping your back and arms down, raise your hips up and off the floor so that your knees are over your chest.
Contract your abs for a moment and then return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet slightly elevated.
Lean your torso back slightly while keeping your spine straight.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Rotate your torso to the opposite side in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: This exercise works your abs by raising your arms to meet your legs. The movements are similar to riding a bike.
Lie on your back on a mat.
Place your hands on either side of your head (over your ears).
Raise your legs up, bending your knees and keeping your calves parallel to the floor.
Bring your left arm elbow up to meet your right knee, as if riding a bike.
Repeat with your right elbow and left knee.
Continue alternating sides.
Note: Move your arms across your chest, squeezing your abs as you move.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
steps: Assume a high plank position with your hands stacked under your shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return the foot to the starting position and immediately drive the opposite knee forward.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with your arms extended toward the ceiling and knees bent at a ninety-degree angle.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg simultaneously toward the floor.
Return both limbs to the starting position and repeat with the opposite side.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Engage your core while keeping your spine neutral.
Extend your right arm forward and your left leg backward simultaneously.
Lower your hand and knee back to the floor and switch sides.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
steps: Stand sideways to a cable machine and hold the handle at chest height with both hands.
Step away from the anchor point to create tension and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out away from your chest.
Return the handle slowly back to your chest against the resistance.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
steps: Attach a handle to a high cable pulley and stand sideways to the machine.
Grab the handle with both hands and rotate your torso away from the pulley.
Pull the cable diagonally downward across your body.
Return the handle slowly to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
steps: Kneel on one knee parallel to a cable machine with the inside knee down.
Hold the cable handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out in front of you.
Return the handle slowly back to your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Hold
steps: Stand sideways to a cable machine and hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Step out to create tension and brace your core firmly.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Hold your arms extended in place against the pull of the cable.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang completely straight.
Engage your core to stabilize your body.
Raise your knees upward toward your chest by flexing your hips and spine.
Lower your knees back down in a controlled manner to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
steps: Step into the captain's chair and place your forearms flat on the pads.
Press your back firmly against the backrest and let your legs hang.
Drive your knees upward toward your chest using your core.
Lower your legs slowly back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
steps: Secure your feet at the top of a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands lightly behind your head.
Flex your spine and curl your torso up toward your knees.
Lower your torso back down with control until your back touches the bench.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight plate securely against your chest.
Contract your abs to lift your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower your upper back slowly back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Weighted Russian Twist
steps: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell with both hands and lean your torso back slightly.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor to balance.
Rotate your torso to one side, bringing the dumbbell toward the floor beside your hip.
Rotate your torso to the opposite side in a smooth motion.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand upright holding a dumbbell in one hand with your arm extended at your side.
Keep your other hand placed behind your head or on your hip.
Bend your torso to the side holding the dumbbell, lowering it down your leg.
Contract your obliques to pull your torso back to the upright starting position.

exercises.name: Elliptical
steps: Step onto the pedals and grip the handles.
Begin pedaling in a smooth, continuous forward motion.
Maintain an upright posture while pushing and pulling the handles.
Slow your cadence gradually to bring the machine to a stop.

exercises.name: Swimming
steps: Enter the water and push off the wall into your streamline position.
Execute your chosen stroke with continuous arm pulls and leg kicks.
Breathe rhythmically to the side or front according to your stroke.
Maintain a steady pace for the duration of your swim.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
steps: Hold the jump rope handles with your hands at hip level and the rope behind your heels.
Swing the rope overhead using your wrists.
Jump slightly off the ground just as the rope approaches your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and prepare for the next rotation.

exercises.name: Assault Bike
steps: Sit on the bike saddle and place your feet securely on the pedals.
Grab the moving handles with both hands.
Push and pull the handles while pedaling to generate wind resistance.
Slow your arm and leg drive gradually to come to a stop.

exercises.name: SkiErg
steps: Stand facing the SkiErg with your feet shoulder-width apart and grab the handles overhead.
Hinge at the hips and pull the handles down explosively using your lats and arms.
Drive your body downward slightly onto your toes as you finish the pull.
Return the handles smoothly to the top as you stand back up.

exercises.name: Hiking
steps: Step onto the trail with a steady, forward-moving stride.
Plant your feet firmly on uneven terrain to maintain balance.
Engage your legs and glutes to power up inclines.
Control your descent on declines by taking measured, deliberate steps.

exercises.name: Treadmill Incline Walk
steps: Step onto the treadmill belt and select an incline level.
Start walking forward at a steady pace.
Maintain contact with the belt continuously.
Slow your pace gradually to stop.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
steps: Grab an end of the battle rope in each hand.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Wave the ropes up and down alternately.
Control the descent of the ropes with each wave.

exercises.name: Incline Push-up
steps: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart on an elevated surface.
Extend your legs behind you and balance on your toes to form a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the surface.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Knee Push-up
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Cross your ankles and engage your core to keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Wide Push-up
steps: Place your hands significantly wider than shoulder-width apart on the floor.
Extend your legs behind you and balance on your toes with a rigid core.
Bend your elbows outward to lower your chest toward the floor.
Press through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Diamond Push-up
steps: Place your hands close together on the floor so your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond shape.
Extend your legs behind you and keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows close to your torso to lower your chest toward your hands.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Decline Push-up
steps: Elevate your feet on a stable surface and place your hands on the floor wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core to maintain a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
steps: Assume a high plank position and walk your feet forward to lift your hips into an inverted V-shape.
Position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart with your head pointing downward.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Feet-Elevated Pike Push-up
steps: Place your feet on an elevated surface and position your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands backward to lift your hips high and form a vertical torso angle.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor in a controlled motion.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Archer Push-up
steps: Place your hands wider than shoulder-width apart on the floor with your fingers turned slightly outward.
Engage your core and keep your body rigid.
Bend one elbow to lower your chest toward that hand while straightening the opposite arm out to the side.
Push through the bending palm to straighten your arm and return to the center position.

exercises.name: Typewriter Push-up
steps: Place your hands wider than shoulder-width apart on the floor in a push-up position.
Lower your chest toward one hand while keeping the opposite arm straight.
Slide your torso across to the opposite hand without rising.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Explosive Push-up
steps: Assume a standard push-up position with your hands under your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the floor.
Push upward with maximum force so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly on your hands and absorb the impact by bending your elbows.

exercises.name: Hindu Push-up
steps: Assume a high plank position with your hands shoulder-width apart and feet wider apart.
Lift your hips upward to form an inverted V shape.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest forward and down toward the floor.
Swoop your torso upward and arch your back while straightening your arms.
Reverse the motion to lift your hips back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-up
steps: Assume a high plank position with your arms fully extended.
Keep your arms straight and pinch your shoulder blades together to lower your chest.
Push the floor away firmly to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Maintain a rigid core throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Push-up Shoulder Tap
steps: Assume a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest to the floor.
Press through your palms to return to the starting plank position.
Lift one hand off the floor to touch the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the floor and repeat the tap on the other side.

exercises.name: Wall Push-up
steps: Stand facing a wall at arm's length and place your palms flat against it at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the wall in a controlled motion.
Press through your palms to push your body back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Wall Walk
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your feet against the base of a wall.
Place your hands on the floor next to your shoulders and press up into a push-up position.
Step your feet up the wall and walk your hands backward toward the base.
Continue walking until your body is nearly vertical against the wall.
Reverse the steps to walk your feet down and return to the floor.

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Push-up
steps: Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting against a wall for support.
Keep your core tight and your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor in a controlled descent.
Press through your palms to extend your arms and push yourself back up.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-up
steps: Kick up into a free-standing handstand without wall support.
Engage your core and maintain full body tension.
Bend your elbows to lower your head smoothly toward the floor.
Press through your hands to extend your elbows and return to the handstand.

exercises.name: Chair Dip
steps: Sit on the edge of a chair and place your hands flat on the edge beside your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the chair with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your elbows to lower your hips straight down toward the floor.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the top.

exercises.name: Doorway Row
steps: Stand in a doorway and grip the frame with both hands at chest height.
Walk your feet forward until your arms are fully extended and lean back slightly.
Pull your chest toward the frame by driving your elbows backward.
Lower your body away from the frame in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Towel Row
steps: Anchor a sturdy towel around a secure vertical post and hold both ends.
Walk your feet forward and lean back with your arms fully extended.
Pull your torso toward the anchor point by driving your elbows back.
Extend your arms slowly to return to the starting lean.

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended overhead in a Y shape.
Engage your upper back and lift your arms off the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower your arms back to the floor in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Prone T Raise
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended straight out to the sides in a T shape.
Lift your arms away from the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly at the top of the lift.
Lower your arms back to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Superman
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended straight overhead.
Engage your core and lower back.
Lift your arms, chest, and legs simultaneously off the floor.
Lower your limbs and torso back to the floor in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended straight overhead.
Engage your lower back and glutes.
Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor.
Hold this elevated position statically.
Lower yourself back to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms resting by your sides and palms facing up.
Lift your chest and hands slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms in an arc overhead while maintaining the height.
Return your arms along the same arc back to your sides in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Step off the platform to let your body hang completely loose.
Relax your shoulders and let your arms extend fully.
Maintain the hanging position.

exercises.name: Active Hang
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Depress your scapulae to pull your shoulders away from your ears.
Engage your lats and core to hold your body stable.
Maintain this active position.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-up
steps: Hang from the pull-up bar with fully extended arms.
Initiate the movement by depressing and retracting your scapulae.
Lift your body slightly upward without bending your elbows.
Lower your body back to the dead hang position with control.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-up
steps: Stand on a box or jump to reach the top position of a pull-up with your chin over the bar.
Hold your body at the top briefly.
Lower yourself as slowly as possible until your arms are fully extended.
Step back onto the box to reset.

exercises.name: Commando Pull-up
steps: Stand under the pull-up bar and grip it with your hands placed close together and palms facing each other.
Pull your body up to one side of the bar.
Alternate the side your head passes on each repetition.
Lower your body back to full arm extension with control.

exercises.name: L-Sit Pull-up
steps: Hang from the pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Raise your legs straight out in front of you parallel to the floor to form an L-shape.
Pull your chest up to the bar while keeping your legs locked in place.
Lower your body and return to the starting hang with control.

exercises.name: Towel Pull-up
steps: Drape two towels over the pull-up bar and grip securely onto the ends.
Hang with your arms fully extended.
Pull your chest up toward your hands by driving your elbows down.
