Lower yourself back to the starting hang with control.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and toes pointing slightly outward.
Initiate the movement by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your hips until your thighs break parallel to the floor.
Drive through your mid-foot to stand back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg with the non-working leg extended straight out in front of you.
Lower your hips down and back while keeping your standing heel flat on the floor.
Descend until your hamstring covers your calf.
Drive through your foot to return to the standing position with control.

exercises.name: Assisted Pistol Squat
steps: Hold onto a stable support with your hands.
Extend one leg forward off the floor.
Lower your hips by bending your working knee.
Push through your midfoot to stand back up.

exercises.name: Shrimp Squat
steps: Stand on one leg and grab your back foot with your hand.
Lower your body by bending your front knee.
Touch your back knee lightly to the floor.
Press through the front foot to return to standing.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
steps: Stand with a very wide stance.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep your opposite leg straight with the toes pointing up.
Drive through the bent leg to return to the center.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
steps: Stand tall and hold onto a support for balance if needed.
Rise up onto your toes.
Push your knees forward while leaning your torso back.
Drive through your toes to extend your knees and hips.

exercises.name: Forward Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet together.
Step forward with one foot.
Lower your hips until both knees form right angles.
Push off the front foot to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet facing forward.
Take a wide step to one side.
Push your hips back and bend that knee into a squat.
Push off the stepping foot to return to standing.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot behind and across the other.
Lower your hips until your front thigh is parallel to the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Skater Squat
steps: Stand on one leg with your free leg hovering behind you.
Lower your body by bending your standing knee.
Tap your back knee gently to the floor.
Press through your standing foot to return to the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Box Squat
steps: Stand in front of a box on one leg.
Extend your other leg straight out in front.
Hinge at the hips and bend your knee to sit down on the box.
Press through your working foot to stand back up.

exercises.name: Step-Down
steps: Stand on a box with one foot and let the other foot hang off the edge.
Lower your hanging foot by bending your supporting knee.
Tap your floating heel lightly on the floor.
Press through your supporting foot to return to the top.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall with your feet flat on the floor.
Rise up onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Lower your heels back down to the floor in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
steps: Stand on one leg with your other foot lifted off the floor.
Raise your heel by pushing through the ball of your foot.
Lower your heel back to the floor in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge March
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift your hips upward by pressing through your heels.
Raise one foot off the floor and bring that knee toward your chest.
Lower that foot back to the floor while keeping your hips elevated.
Lower your hips to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Frog Pump
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet pressed together and knees flared outward.
Drive through the outer edges of your feet to lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes tightly at the top of the movement.
Lower your hips back down to the floor in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
steps: Start on your hands and knees on the floor in a tabletop position.
Keep your knee bent at a ninety-degree angle as you lift one leg upward.
Press the sole of your foot toward the ceiling until your thigh aligns with your torso.
Lower your leg back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
steps: Get on your hands and knees on the floor in a tabletop position.
Keep your knee bent at a ninety-degree angle and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise your knee as high as possible without rotating your torso.
Lower your leg back to the starting position in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Clamshell
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent at a ninety-degree angle and your hips stacked.
Keep your feet pressed together as you raise your top knee upward.
Open your legs like a clam shell without rotating your lower back.
Lower your top knee back down to meet the bottom knee in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Hip Airplane
steps: Stand on one leg and hinge forward slightly at your hips with your arms extended for balance.
Rotate your pelvis and torso toward your standing leg.
Rotate your pelvis open in the opposite direction away from your standing leg.
Return your hips to a neutral level position in a controlled movement.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked directly on top of each other.
Keep your top leg straight and lift it upward toward the ceiling.
Lead slightly with your heel while keeping your toes pointed forward.
Lower your leg back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie on your side with both legs fully extended and stacked.
Raise your top leg upward in a smooth arc toward the ceiling.
Pause briefly at the top of the lift.
Lower your leg back down to the bottom position in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Walkout
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your heels on the floor.
Lift your hips upward to form a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Walk your heels outward step by step until your legs are nearly straight.
Walk your heels back inward to the starting position and lower your hips in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Towel Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and place your heels on a towel on a slick floor.
Lift your hips off the floor into a bridge position.
Slide your heels away from your body until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your glutes by curling your legs and lower your hips in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Stability Ball Hamstring Curl
steps: Lie on your back and place your heels on top of a stability ball.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling until your body forms a straight line.
Roll the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Roll the ball back out and lower your hips to the floor in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Banded Glute Bridge
steps: Place a resistance band around your thighs just above your knees and lie on your back.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor hip-width apart.
Push your knees slightly outward against the band and drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Lower your hips back down to the floor in a controlled motion.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Thrust
steps: Place a resistance band around your thighs just above your knees.
Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench.
Drive your hips upward by squeezing your glutes.
Lower your hips back down in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Banded Frog Pump
steps: Loop a resistance band around your thighs just above your knees.
Lie on your back with the soles of your feet pressed together and knees dropped open.
Drive your hips upward by pressing the outer edges of your feet into the floor.
Lower your hips back down to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshell
steps: Place a resistance band around your legs just above your knees.
Lie on your side with your knees bent at a right angle and feet stacked.
Raise your top knee upward against the band.
Lower your top knee back down to meet the bottom knee with control.

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
steps: Step inside a resistance band and position it around your lower legs or thighs.
Assume a partial squat stance with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step to the side with one foot to stretch the band.
Follow with the other foot while maintaining tension on the band.

exercises.name: Banded Monster Walk
steps: Place a resistance band around your ankles.
Bend your knees slightly into an athletic stance.
Step forward and outward at an angle with one foot.
Step forward and outward with the other foot while controlling the band.

exercises.name: Banded Squat
steps: Step inside a resistance band and place it across your upper back.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower your body.
Drive through your feet to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Banded Donkey Kick
steps: Loop a resistance band around one foot and hold the other end with your hands on the floor.
Get on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Kick your banded foot upward toward the ceiling.
Lower your leg back down to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Fire Hydrant
steps: Place a resistance band around your thighs just above your knees.
Get on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Lift one leg out to the side while keeping your knee bent.
Lower your leg back down to the starting position under control.

exercises.name: Banded Kickback
steps: Secure a resistance band to a low anchor point and attach the other end to your ankle.
Stand facing the anchor point while holding a support for balance.
Press your banded leg straight back behind you.
Return your leg to the starting position in a controlled manner.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Place a resistance band around your ankles.
Stand tall while holding a support for balance.
Lift your outer leg out to the side against the band.
Lower your leg back to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Seated Hip Abduction
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench and place a resistance band around your thighs.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your knees outward against the band.
Return your knees to the starting position under control.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
steps: Hold a resistance band with both hands in front of your chest with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart horizontally by moving your arms outward.
Return your hands to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Face Pull
steps: Attach a resistance band to an anchor point at face height.
Grab the band with both hands and step back to create tension.
Pull the band toward your face while flaring your elbows outward.
Return the band to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Row
steps: Anchor a resistance band securely in front of you.
Hold the handles with your arms extended and sit or stand tall.
Pull the band toward your torso by driving your elbows back.
Extend your arms to return the band to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Lat Pulldown
steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead.
Grab the band with both hands wider than shoulder-width.
Pull the band down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down.
Raise your arms to return the band to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Pallof Press
steps: Anchor a resistance band at chest height to your side.
Hold the band with both hands close to your chest and step away to create tension.
Press the band straight out in front of your chest.
Bend your arms to return the band to your chest with control.

exercises.name: Banded Woodchop
steps: Anchor a resistance band high or low to your side.
Grab the band with both hands and rotate your torso away from the anchor.
Pull the band diagonally across your body.
Rotate your torso to return the band to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Banded Dead Bug
steps: Anchor a resistance band behind you and hold the ends with your arms extended upward.
Lie on your back with your knees bent at a right angle and feet lifted.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor simultaneously.
Return your arm and leg to the starting position with control.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the ground simultaneously.
Extend your arms straight past your ears.
Press your lower back firmly into the floor and hold the position.

exercises.name: Hollow Rock
steps: Assume a hollow body hold position with your arms and legs extended.
Rock your body forward by lifting your upper torso slightly higher.
Rock your body backward by lifting your legs higher.
Maintain the curved body shape continuously throughout the rocking motion.

exercises.name: V-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back with your arms and legs extended.
Raise your upper body and straight legs toward each other simultaneously.
Touch your toes at the top of the movement.
Lower your torso and legs back to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Flutter Kick
steps: Lie flat on your back with your hands placed underneath your glutes.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in a small, alternating motion.
Keep your legs straight and maintain the movement continuously.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and hands by your sides.
Lift your legs upward toward the ceiling while keeping them straight.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement.
Lower your legs back down to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Toe Touch
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended straight up toward the ceiling.
Reach your arms upward toward your feet.
Lift your shoulder blades off the floor to touch your toes.
Lower your upper body back to the floor with control.

exercises.name: Heel Tap
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Extend your arms flat by your sides and lift your shoulders slightly off the ground.
Crunch your torso to one side and touch your heel with your hand.
Return to the starting position with control.
Crunch your torso to the opposite side and touch your heel with your hand.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Tap
steps: Assume a high plank position with your hands placed directly under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Lift one hand off the floor and tap the opposite shoulder.
Lower your hand back to the floor with control.
Lift the other hand and tap the opposite shoulder.

exercises.name: Plank Jack
steps: Assume a high plank position with your feet together.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet outward wide apart.
Jump your feet inward together with control.

exercises.name: Bear Plank
steps: Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position.
Tuck your toes and lift your knees a few inches off the floor.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Hold this position statically.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
steps: Start on your hands and knees in a bear plank position with knees hovering off the floor.
Step forward with your right hand and left foot simultaneously.
Step forward with your left hand and right foot simultaneously.
Continue alternating sides with control.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
steps: Sit on the floor with your feet flat and hands placed behind you on the ground.
Lift your hips off the floor into a reverse tabletop position.
Step forward with your right hand and left foot.
Step forward with your left hand and right foot, maintaining a lifted hip position.
Lower your hips to the floor with control when finished.

exercises.name: Inchworm
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend at your hips and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until you reach a high plank position.
Walk your feet forward toward your hands with control.
Stand up to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold
steps: Place two parallettes or sturdy objects on the floor and grip the handles.
Press down into your hands to lift your body off the floor.
Extend your legs straight out in front of you parallel to the floor.
Hold this L-shape position statically with your core braced.

exercises.name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on the floor and lean your torso back slightly while lifting your feet.
Brace your core and balance on your sit bones.
Draw your knees inward toward your chest.
Extend your legs outward away from your torso with control.

exercises.name: Side Plank Hip Dip
steps: Assume a side plank position resting on your forearm with your feet stacked.
Brace your core and lift your hips high.
Lower your hips toward the floor with control.
Raise your hips back up to the starting position.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
steps: Get into a side plank position with your top foot resting on a bench or elevated surface.
Keep your bottom leg lifted off the floor or resting underneath.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Hold this elevated position statically.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
steps: Lie on a bench and grip a secure anchor point behind your head.
Lift your entire body straight up until only your upper back touches the bench.
Keep your body completely rigid and straight.
Lower your body down toward the bench with control.

exercises.name: Burpee
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a squat position and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank position.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up into a plank and jump your feet forward to your hands.
Explode upward into the air with your arms overhead.

exercises.name: Half Burpee
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body and place your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a high plank position.
Reverse the motion by jumping your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up to return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Squat Thrust
steps: Stand upright with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
Drop into a deep squat while placing your hands flat on the floor.
Shoot your legs backward until your body forms a straight line in a plank.
Quickly jump your feet forward back into the squat position.
Drive through your legs to stand back up.

exercises.name: High Knees
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Drive one knee upward toward your chest.
Lower that foot while simultaneously driving the opposite knee upward.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your leg movement.
Maintain a fast pace while landing softly on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while simultaneously raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together while lowering your arms to your sides.
Maintain a steady rhythm and soft knees upon landing.

exercises.name: Skater Hop
steps: Stand on your right leg with your knee slightly bent and your left foot behind your right ankle.
Push off your right foot to leap laterally to the left.
Land softly on your left foot while sweeping your right foot behind your left ankle.
Absorb the impact by bending your left knee and hip.
Push off your left foot to leap back to the right.

exercises.name: Lateral Shuffle
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and assume an athletic stance with knees bent.
Step laterally to the right with your right foot.
Follow quickly by bringing your left foot to meet your right foot.
Continue taking rapid side steps in the same direction.
Reverse direction by leading with your left foot.

exercises.name: Fast Feet
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Alternate tapping your feet up and down as rapidly as possible.
Keep your core engaged and your upper body stable.
Maintain a low center of gravity throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Sprawl
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Drop your hands to the floor and kick your feet backward.
Lower your hips and chest completely to the floor.
Push up aggressively with your upper body.
Jump your feet forward back underneath your hips and stand up.

exercises.name: Seal Jack
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms extended straight out in front of you at shoulder height.
Jump your feet apart while simultaneously opening your arms wide to the sides.
Jump your feet back together while bringing your arms back out in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and parallel to the floor throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
steps: Start on your hands and knees with a neutral spine in a tabletop position.
Exhale and arch your spine toward the ceiling while tucking your chin.
Inhale and drop your abdomen toward the floor while lifting your chest and tailbone.
Flow smoothly between the two positions.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
steps: Stand tall with your arms extended straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Begin rotating your arms forward in small, controlled circles.
Gradually increase the size of the circles while keeping your torso steady.
Reverse the direction of the rotation to circle your arms backward.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step forward into a long lunge with your right foot.
Place your left hand on the floor and rotate your torso to the right.
Reach your right arm up toward the ceiling.
Lower your arm and return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Leg Swings
steps: Stand tall and hold onto a stable surface for balance.
Swing one leg forward and backward in a controlled motion.
Reverse the direction by swinging the leg across your body if needed.
Return the foot to the floor.

exercises.name: Torso Twists
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed.
Rotate your torso to the left rapidly.
Pivot your right heel as you swing to the right.
Alternate the rotation continuously.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: Stand in a doorway with your forearms against the frame.
Step forward slightly to feel a stretch across your chest.
Hold the position while breathing deeply.
Step back to release the tension.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
steps: Kneel on the floor with your knees wide and big toes touching.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward on the floor.
Lower your chest toward the ground.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
steps: Kneel on your right knee and place your left foot flat in front.
Tighten your glutes and shift your hips forward.
Hold the stretch at the front of your hip.
Release the pressure by shifting your hips back.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
steps: Extend one leg forward with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge at your hips and lean your torso forward.
Reach your hands down toward your shin.
Return to a standing position.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
steps: Stand on one leg while holding a support for balance.
Grab your opposite foot behind you with your hand.
Pull your heel gently toward your glutes.
Lower your foot back to the floor.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended straight in front.
Hinge at your hips and reach forward.
Grab your toes or shins.
Release your grip and sit back up.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
steps: Bring one arm straight across the front of your chest.
Use your opposite arm to pull the elbow closer to your body.
Hold the stretch in your shoulder.
Lower your arm back to your side.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
steps: Face a wall and place your hands flat against it.
Step one foot back with your heel flat on the floor.
Bend your front knee and lean forward into the wall.
Step your back foot forward to release.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Pull your heels close to your groin.
Press your knees gently down toward the floor.
Release your knees and straighten your legs.
